profiles_signal_len.name: profiles_signal_len
profiles_signal_len.value: "profiles"."signal" is null or char_length("profiles"."signal") between 1 and 80

profiles_bio_len.name: profiles_bio_len
profiles_bio_len.value: "profiles"."bio" is null or char_length("profiles"."bio") between 1 and 150

reports_not_self.name: reports_not_self
reports_not_self.value: "reports"."reporter_id" is distinct from "reports"."target_user_id" or "reports"."reporter_id" is null

suspensions_timed_idx.name: suspensions_timed_idx
suspensions_timed_idx.where: "suspensions"."lifted_at" is null and "suspensions"."ends_at" is not null

suspensions_appeal_pair.name: suspensions_appeal_pair
suspensions_appeal_pair.value: ("suspensions"."appeal_text" is null) = ("suspensions"."appealed_at" is null) and ("suspensions"."appeal_text" is null) = ("suspensions"."appeal_status" is null)

porch_lights_note_len.name: porch_lights_note_len
porch_lights_note_len.value: "porch_lights"."note" is null or char_length("porch_lights"."note") between 1 and 60
